headline: Psychology Graduate Turned Digital Marketer
specialisms: Paid Ads, Social Media & Content Marketing | Business Analysis Background
intro: My career path has been a journey of discovering where I can make the most meaningful contribution.
storyTitle: From understanding people to helping businesses reach them.
paragraphs: I studied psychology because I was curious about people: how they think, what they need and what influences their decisions. My early experience in the field strengthened that interest.

I later moved into business analysis, where I learned to understand business problems and make complex ideas easier to act on through requirements documents, process maps, UML and BPMN diagrams, architecture visuals and infographics.

Over time, I started noticing a familiar challenge in businesses around me, including those of family and friends. They had valuable products or services, but needed clearer ways to explain them, reach the right audience and turn attention into enquiries. I saw an opportunity to bring my interests and skills together, and digital marketing became the direction I wanted to pursue.

Since August 2026, digital marketing has been my professional focus, especially paid advertising, social media marketing and content marketing. My background helps me look at marketing from several useful angles: the people we want to reach, the business goal behind the campaign, and the message and visuals that make an offer clear.

I like to start with the audience and objective, then plan the content or campaign and learn from the response. I’m currently focused on helping e-commerce and service businesses with business analysis, paid ads and content marketing.
invitation: If you’re working on helping people discover your products or services and giving them clearer reasons to buy, I’d be glad to connect.
facts: More than two years in business analysis
